qr_decode_modules — SYMBOL datacode2d op

• Data kinds: matrix → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.qr_decode_modules(modules) -> 'dict' (to call the implementation directly, import qrsym; qrsym.qr_decode_modules(modules) -> 'dict'; from the registry, opssymbol.get("qr_decode_modules"))

• GPU: none (CPU reference implementation only)

Usage

Decode a QR module grid (no quiet zone, 1 = dark) and return the corrected codewords per block (table).

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

Decode an (N,N) 0/1 module grid (1 = dark, no quiet zone). The transposed (mirrored) grid is tried when the direct read fails.

Returns a dict with text, version, ec_level, mask, mode, modes, n_corrected, block_corrected, block_ec, block_capacity (= floor((n_ec - p)/2)), block_p (誤復号保護語 / misdecode-protection codewords), blocks, mirrored, format_distance and codeword_index. In the mirrored case codeword_index refers to the transposed (read) grid; transpose it to index the input grid.

Raises QRDecodeError when neither orientation decodes.
